scientific_integrity: An analytic global-injectivity argument, exact-rational counterexample, and independently reproducible numerical checks support a mathematically conditional theorem; the model is idealized, with no new field data, noise analysis, independent audit, or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only four homogeneous equally spaced visits; each site has a stationary conditional two-state process with strictly positive memory.
Unknown structural occupancy is distinct from conditional local availability; no false positives and conditional independent detections are assumed.
Only exact population-level per-site count histograms are identifiable; finite-sample stability is unproved and poor near excluded boundaries.
title: Four unordered detection counts identify occupancy, availability persistence, and sensitivity
